# Atlas v2 — Complete 3×3 Matrix Analysis (9 Cells)

**Generated**: 2026-05-15 | **Version**: v2_9cells | **Previous**: v2 (8 cells, missing gpt2xl_topk50)

## 1. 3×3 Signal Strength Matrix

### 4-Class RF Accuracy

| Model | nucleus p=0.95 | temp τ=0.9 | top-k k=50 | Δ(best−worst) |
|-------|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| **Pythia-1.4B** | 78.2% | 76.3% | 69.6% | 8.52pp |
| **OLMo-1B** | 78.8% | 82.0% | 74.2% | 7.83pp |
| **GPT-2 XL** | 83.3% | 85.4% | 74.5% | **10.97pp** |

**Mean**: 78.03% (std=4.72pp) | **Best**: gpt2xl_temp09 (85.4%) | **Worst**: pythia_topk50 (69.6%)

### d1-vs-d2 AUC (RF)

| Model | nucleus | temp09 | topk50 |
|-------|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| **Pythia-1.4B** | 0.861 | 0.833 | 0.752 |
| **OLMo-1B** | 0.867 | 0.901 | 0.831 |
| **GPT-2 XL** | 0.913 | 0.937 | 0.813 |

## 2. Model-Strategy Interaction Effects

### GPT-2 XL top-k sensitivity (Director focus)

GPT-2 XL shows the largest accuracy drop under top-k truncation:

| Model | temp09 → topk50 | Δ accuracy | Δ d2v3 AUC |
|-------|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| **GPT-2 XL** | 85.4% → 74.5% | **-10.97pp** | 0.882 → 0.753 (−0.129) |
| **OLMo-1B** | 82.0% → 74.2% | −7.83pp | 0.821 → 0.736 (−0.086) |
| **Pythia-1.4B** | 76.3% → 69.6% | −6.62pp | 0.793 → 0.692 (−0.101) |

**Interpretation**: GPT-2 XL 对 top-k 更敏感的原因：
- top-k 硬截断将 GPT-2 XL 较高的 baseline 信号（d2v3 AUC 0.882）大幅压缩，因为 top-k 消除了 tail distribution 中的 depth-informative tokens
- GPT-2 XL 在 nucleus/temp 下的优势恰恰来自 tail token variance（var_surprisal 是其 top-2 feature），top-k 截断直接打击这一优势
- OLMo-1B 更依赖 p90_ppl（percentile-based），受 top-k 影响较小

### Accuracy range per model (across strategies)
- GPT-2 XL: 10.97pp → highest interaction effect
- Pythia-1.4B: 8.52pp
- OLMo-1B: 7.83pp → most robust across strategies

## 3. EDD Matrix (Effective Discrimination Depth)

### Threshold = 0.80

| Model | nucleus | temp09 | topk50 |
|-------|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| **Pythia-1.4B** | 3 | 2 | **1** |
| **OLMo-1B** | 3 | 3 | 2 |
| **GPT-2 XL** | 3 | 3 | **2** |

### Cells with EDD < 3 (signal saturation)

| Cell | EDD@0.80 | d1v2 AUC | d2v3 AUC | Bottleneck |
|------|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---|
| pythia_topk50 | **1** | 0.752 | 0.692 | d1v2 already < 0.80 |
| pythia_temp09 | 2 | 0.833 | 0.793 | d2v3 < 0.80 |
| olmo_topk50 | 2 | 0.831 | 0.736 | d2v3 < 0.80 |
| gpt2xl_topk50 | 2 | 0.813 | 0.753 | d2v3 < 0.80 |

### EDD sensitivity across thresholds

| Threshold | Mean EDD | Std | Min | Max |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| 0.65 | 3.00 | 0.00 | 3 | 3 |
| 0.70 | 2.89 | 0.31 | 2 | 3 |
| 0.75 | 2.67 | 0.47 | 2 | 3 |
| 0.80 | 2.56 | 0.68 | 1 | 3 |

**Most sensitive**: pythia_topk50 (EDD range=2, drops from 3→1)
**Least sensitive**: pythia_nucleus, olmo_nucleus, olmo_temp09, gpt2xl_nucleus, gpt2xl_temp09 (always EDD=3)

## 4. Feature Importance Consistency

### Universal ranking (mean across 9 cells)

| Rank | Feature | Mean Importance | CV | Stability |
|:---:|---------|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| 1 | **p90_ppl** | 0.1946 | 0.208 | ★★★★ |
| 2 | **var_surprisal** | 0.1612 | 0.193 | ★★★★ |
| 3 | p75_ppl | 0.1025 | 0.285 | ★★★ |
| 4 | mean_surprisal | 0.0969 | 0.228 | ★★★ |
| 5 | mean_ppl | 0.0510 | 0.976 | ★ |

### Top-2 consistency across cells

- **p90_ppl**: top-2 in **9/9** cells (100%) ← universal dominant feature
- **var_surprisal**: top-2 in **7/9** cells (78%)
- mean_surprisal: top-2 in 1/9 (gpt2xl_temp09 only)
- p75_ppl: top-2 in 1/9 (gpt2xl_topk50 only)

**Conclusion**: p90_ppl + var_surprisal are the universal top-2 features. The only exception: GPT-2 XL cells where p90_ppl dominates more (>0.24), pushing var_surprisal to rank 3-4 and elevating p75_ppl or mean_surprisal.

### Cross-model rank correlation

| Strategy | Mean ρ | n_models |
|----------|:---:|:---:|
| nucleus_p095 | 0.8005 | 3 |
| temperature_09 | 0.7461 | 3 |
| topk_k50 | **0.8107** | **3** ← new (was 2) |

topk_k50 with 3 models: OLMo-1B vs GPT-2 XL ρ=0.981 (strongest pairwise), Pythia-1.4B vs GPT-2 XL ρ=0.715 (weakest).

## 5. Δ from 8-Cell Version

| Metric | 8-cell | 9-cell | Change |
|--------|:---:|:---:|:---|
| Mean RF accuracy | 78.47% | 78.03% | −0.44pp (gpt2xl_topk50 pulls down) |
| topk_k50 mean ρ | 0.7363 (2 models) | **0.8107** (3 models) | +0.074, now strongest strategy |
| EDD@0.80 cells<3 | 3/8 | **4/9** | gpt2xl_topk50 adds another EDD=2 |
| Feature top-2 consistency | p90_ppl 8/8, var_surprisal 6/8 | p90_ppl **9/9**, var_surprisal **7/9** | Maintains pattern |
| GPT-2 XL acc_range | 2.09pp (2 strats) | **10.97pp** (3 strats) | top-k reveals strong interaction |

## 6. Key Takeaways

1. **Top-k 是最具挑战性的解码策略**: 所有模型在 top-k 下 accuracy 最低，且 4/9 个 EDD<3 的 cell 有 3 个是 top-k
2. **GPT-2 XL 对 top-k 最敏感** (−10.97pp)：其优势来自 tail distribution variance，top-k 截断直接消除这一信号
3. **p90_ppl + var_surprisal 是 model-agnostic 的 depth fingerprint**: 9/9 和 7/9 cells 中分别为 top-2
4. **跨模型一致性在 top-k 下最强** (ρ=0.811)：top-k 的确定性截断使不同模型的 feature landscape 更相似
5. **OLMo-1B 是最鲁棒的模型**: accuracy range 仅 7.83pp，跨策略表现最稳定
REPORT_EOF
